purpose: Validate one explicit causal SMC/ICT scenario rather than another return-fitting filter: prior dealing range defines external liquidity; a completed bar must sweep and reject it; completed one-minute bars must then produce opposite displacement, CHoCH and a three-candle FVG; price must retrace into and reject the FVG; entry activates one completed minute later; invalidation is beyond the sweep extreme and the objective is the opposite pre-sweep external liquidity. Run adjacent 60/90/120-minute dealing ranges on the same two locked BTC development weeks with NautilusTrader 1.230.0, current-NAV risk 3%, unchanged costs, no notional cap, and scenario-transition diagnostics.
